TextBlock.Text: TANKER WAR FEARS RISE AS SOVIET RAIDERS REPORTED SOUTH OF CEYLON

StackPanel.TextBlock: Shipping insurers and naval authorities confirmed overnight reports that Soviet surface units have entered the wider Indian Ocean theater. Merchant traffic has been rerouted while allied maritime headquarters evaluate the danger to the vital oil and container routes linking the Persian Gulf, East Africa, India, and Australia.Military spokesmen in Canberra and Pearl Harbor described the situation as serious but manageable, emphasizing that coalition naval forces are already moving to cover the most exposed sea lanes.Defense analysts warn that a sustained Soviet interdiction effort could complicate reinforcement of the Pacific and Middle East theaters within days.
